# The experiments of alpha

The authored table. It is stale by construction: an experiment present on disk and
absent from this table enters the index with a status that says so.

| id | question | status |
|---|---|---|
| [E01](E01-ruling.md) | does the control sequence hold across a turn | RULED |
| [E02](E02-ruling.md) | does the second bridge survive the turn | CLOSED |
| [E03] | does the third arc open at all | pending, nobody has said |

## How to read this table

The status column is a second verdict vocabulary, distinct from the one the rulings
use. The E03 row's status carries no declared status word, so the experiment-status
vocabulary reports it as unrecognised rather than filing it under a word nobody wrote.
